seo_title: Delhi HC Orders Zomato to Delist 132 'Kake Da' Ads
title: Delhi HC Directs Zomato to Take Down 132 Listings Using 'Kake Da' Names
case_name: Kakas Hospitality Private Limited v. Eternal Limited (Zomato) & Ors.
card_summary: Kakas Hospitality, owner of the KAKE-DA-HOTEL mark, held an earlier injunction against restaurants using similar names. It returned to court over 132 new Zomato listings such as 'Kaka Da Dhaba' and 'Kake Da Chicken'. Justice Tejas Karia held these adopted the essential feature of an already-restrained mark and directed Zomato's operator, Eternal Limited, to take them down and disclose the operators' details.
card_tip: A mark owner fighting look-alike food delivery listings should keep monitoring after the first injunction; a fresh application naming the new listings, not a contempt plea, is the quicker route to a further takedown.
verification_notes: The plaintiff (Kakas Hospitality), its KAKE-DA-HOTEL mark, the case number CS(COMM) 392/2026, the judge (Justice Tejas Karia), the 132 listings, the named examples of infringing listing names, and the direction to Zomato's operator Eternal Limited to take them down and disclose the operators' particulars are reported consistently by LiveLaw Biz and SupremeToday. LiveLaw Biz dates the order to 6 November 2026 and notes the interim order traces back to an order of 21 July 2026 in the same suit; that background order was not independently verified beyond this reference. The order itself was seen only through these two secondary reports, not opened and read in full.
